label: capitalnest.github.io/bitcoinN.io-claim--HGFV76HD1
title: BitcoinN.io
reasons: Fake 'locked Bitcoin voucher' shows €300 in BTC and requires a USDT 'gas fee' to withdraw, a classic advance-fee scam
Hardcoded share code (64745365) unlocks a simulated wallet; withdrawal is blocked by a $0 USDT balance and pushes the victim to buy USDT via P2P to pay the fee
The page solicits money under a false premise: the locked asset and required network fee are fictional

label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: Page copy is a classic wallet-drain lure: 'Click here to rectify all strange wallet issues', 'CLAIM AIRDROP', 'MISSING/IRREGULAR BALANCE', 'ASSET RECOVERY' — all designed to get a user to connect a wallet or reveal a seed phrase.
Bundled JS includes a fake wallet picker (Trust Wallet, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet) alongside 'seedPhrase' and 'privkey' strings, matching the drainer pattern.
Repo is literally 'known-bad' via canary path and triggered high-confidence signals (drain_copy, fake_wallet_picker, seed, privkey).
